indexes.expression: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX carts_guest_active_unique ON public.carts USING btree (guest_session_id) WHERE ((guest_session_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((kind)::text = 'active'::text) AND (merged_at IS NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX carts_user_active_unique ON public.carts USING btree (user_id) WHERE ((user_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((kind)::text = 'active'::text) AND (merged_at IS NULL))
CREATE INDEX checkout_quotes_reservation_id_index ON public.checkout_quotes USING btree (reservation_id) WHERE (reservation_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX checkout_stock_reservations_active_inventory_expires_index ON public.checkout_stock_reservations USING btree (inventory_id, expires_at) WHERE ((status)::text = 'active'::text)
CREATE INDEX checkout_stock_reservations_active_quote_expires_index ON public.checkout_stock_reservations USING btree (quote_id, expires_at) WHERE ((status)::text = 'active'::text)
CREATE INDEX checkout_stock_reservations_active_quote_inventory_index ON public.checkout_stock_reservations USING btree (quote_id, inventory_id) WHERE ((status)::text = 'active'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_addresses_unique_primary_per_user ON public.user_addresses USING btree (user_id) WHERE (is_primary = true)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX variant_prices_active_base_unique ON public.variant_prices USING btree (product_inventory_id) WHERE ((market_code IS NULL) AND (active_to IS NULL))
